tokens.name: tn-switch-on

tokens.name: tn-stop-soft

tokens.name: tn-stop-ink
tokens.usage: Thiṇai mode. Red text: on stop-soft, a wrong answer's ring. 7:1+ on stop-soft and panel in every theme. Light is Mullai (the default landscape); dark is Thiṇai's Night.

tokens.name: tn-focus
tokens.usage: Thiṇai mode. Keyboard focus ring, 3px, offset 4px. Yazhi Cobalt by day, a light cobalt at night; 3:1+ on every surface. Light is Mullai (the default landscape); dark is Thiṇai's Night.

tokens.name: tn-mission
tokens.usage: Thiṇai mode. Mission Control's ring and its 14% wash (Bubble's gold): the bordered flat bubble around the Yazhi mark. 4.5:1+ on every surface. Light is Mullai (the default landscape); dark is Thiṇai's Night.

tokens.name: tn-state
tokens.usage: Thiṇai mode. The 2px ring that marks the selected item (current nav page, current app, chosen option). 4.5:1+ against panel so selection never relies on a pale fill. Light is Mullai (the default landscape); dark is Thiṇai's Night.

tokens.name: tn-control-edge
